correctness.rationale: For graph distance d_C5(i,j)+1_{a != b} at inclusive radius 2, every simplex lies in the adjacent-two-column core B, a middle-column F_{i,a}, or one monochromatic full-row simplex R_a. Outside B each F_{i,a} collapses by a free long-edge pairing, so U collapses to B and B to the row C5. Each R_a meets U in the five-triangle Möbius band M_a with a simplicial collapse onto the row C5; its inclusion into U is a homotopy equivalence. First contractible row fills the generator of pi1 U, other m-1 row simplices attach on nullhomotopic circles, giving ∨^{m-1}S2 integrally. Independently rebuilt complete scale-2 cliques and F2 homology for m=3,4,5: 433,1564,5815 nonempty faces and beta2=2,3,4 with all other reduced Betti zero.
residual_risks: Uniform cover and pushout proof, not merely finite computations, supports all m>=3; no statement for n !=5 or other scales.
